acceptance_row_text: Wrong/missing UUID prevents affected writes with no fallback. Prebuilder receipt proves actual recurring jobID, supported interval, nextRun, immediate tick acknowledgement and one control owner. Unsupported scheduling holds product-builder admission with exact blocker; read-only T01 continues. Pending/uncertain identities remain counted. The startup receipt retains the registered prompt body or exact portable reference+version/digest. The immediate tick proves an executed decision/action and actual-result acknowledgement through the single existing owner; a heartbeat-only prompt fails. Every unfinished assignment is classified and ready QC/repair/integration/cleanup work is serviced by that full cycle. If no safe task is admissible, record an evidence-backed admission/hold decision with actual classification, cause, owner and acknowledged outcome; never fabricate a dispatch. Prefer a supported safe read-only assignment when admissible. Keep ticks bounded; long builds/tests belong to workers.
